lifter.method: lift() accepts jmp, in-range conditional branches, and loop/jecxz before insn(); other forms are decided by Lifter.insn on one instruction of each operand form. Strings are discarded

feasibility.choice: PROTECTED STARTUP IS A FUNDAMENTAL BLOCKER
feasibility.why: .text is largely ordinary MSVC code and the reached body is mostly self-contained, so instruction coverage is not what blocks a port. The PE entry point 0x01FCA510 is not in .text. Adapting the lifter would translate a body the PE header does not enter. Reaching that body from the real entry means following the protected startup, which this analysis does not do.

gaps.title: The PE entry point is outside .text
gaps.detail: Entry 0x01FCA510 is in Sitext. tools/genall.py seeds discovery there and then stops, because the walk is limited to .text. This run did not disassemble that section.

gaps.title: Direct edges from reached .text into protected-layout sections
Lifter.insn rejects some reached instructions
gaps.detail: 1264 of 874653 reached instructions are unsupported. lock xadd x111, salc x90, lcall x72, aas x67, iretd x66, mov x64, ljmp x62, movmskps x61, aaa x59, das x59, aad x58, int1 x54

gaps.title: MSVC switch pattern from tools/lift.py
gaps.detail: 328 jump tables match _jt_bound/_jt_table (122 of them use the movzx byte table). 401 indirect jumps have the [reg*4+disp] shape, 840 cmp/ja bounds were recorded, and 8 jmp blocks sat on a bound but were rejected. Targets were not guessed when the pattern did not match.

gaps.title: Indirect calls and jumps have no proven targets
gaps.detail: Reached code has 10365 register/memory indirect calls, 741 indirect jumps, 0 call [IAT], and 0 jmp [IAT]. The lifter already lowers an indirect call to DISPATCH_CALL. It does not recover a vtable target, and a jmp [reg*4+disp] that fails the switch matcher stays indirect.

gaps.title: .text has no absolute call or jump through the PE IAT
gaps.detail: The IAT directory is ['0x022CD82F', '0x022CE257'], inside the .securom address range. Absolute indirect branches at that range in the linear sweep: 0. Reached code contains 0 call [IAT] and 0 jmp [IAT]. NFSU2's import path is an absolute call or jump through an IAT slot, which runtime/win32.c rewrites. Reached indirect calls are call reg or call [mem], with no static target. If those ever reach MSVCR80 or MSVCP80, win32_call still pops nargs as if the callee were stdcall.

gaps.title: Function discovery has call targets but no relocations
gaps.detail: 13090 direct-call targets land on a decoded instruction. 795 call targets are not on an instruction boundary and were not used. tools/reloc2.py still has no unnamed reloc section to read, and IMAGE_FILE_RELOCS_STRIPPED is set. Call edges replace that seed only for functions that are called directly.

gaps.title: Prologues are evidence, not entries
gaps.detail: The byte sequence 55 8B EC occurs 4637 times. 4621 of those are at an instruction boundary, and 3069 of the strong call targets begin with it. 1238 boundary prologues sit after int3 padding and are not direct call targets, so they were not used as roots.

gaps.title: The image does not fit the NFSU2 guest map
gaps.detail: Image base 0x00400000 matches, but SizeOfImage is 0x020A5000 (0x024A5000). runtime/heap.c treats 0x00400000..0x00932000 as the image. The .text end 0x00B603FB is already past that window.

gaps.title: Stack commit is 4 MB
gaps.detail: The PE optional header, measured by tools/uc_analyze.py, asks for 0x400000 bytes of stack commit and 0x800000 reserved. The web worker stack is about 1 MB.
